description: Revert to the proven stable Depth=8 configuration with Total Batch Size 2^19 and optimized hyperparameters (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4) to maximize gradient signal-to-noise ratio and ensure robust convergence, as previous attempts to increase depth consistently failed due to optimization instability and VRAM constraints, while fine-tuning the learning rate schedule to target the 0.9834 benchmark.
